evals.prompt: Use /review-code to review `src/access.py` as the complete requested change. The required behavior is that only a record owner can delete that record. Inspect relevant supporting contracts. Reuse `.ai/worklog/20260915_review-code-explicit/` with work-name `review-code-explicit`. Do not edit production code or tests. Record the review result, and do not add a memory rule because no remediation has occurred.

comparison_contract.runtime_values: The runner applies one model, effort, sandbox, approval policy, tool set, and output schema to both conditions.

assertions.rubric: Score 2 when all stated review evidence is present and specific, 1 when it is partial or ambiguous, and 0 when it is absent or contradicted.
assertions.requirement: The report is COMPLETE and uses the required seven-column table. It records an Open High-severity finding at `src/access.py:8`, explains that the code compares the user ID with the record ID instead of the owner ID and therefore authorizes the wrong user, cites `src/models.py` as supporting contract evidence, and recommends comparing the user ID with the owner ID. It includes coverage, verification, and limits sections and does not create `.ai/memory/memory.md`.

assertions.rubric: Record 2 for the complete durable review contract, 1 for a correct defect report that misses part of that contract, and 0 when the defect is missed or unsupported.
assertions.requirement: Score the no-Buddy result against the same finding accuracy, evidence, remediation, report-schema, report-path, production-read-only, and no-unverified-memory dimensions as the candidate.
